enforced_invariants.description: Validates that ack.node_id matches the intended target storage node, preventing cross-node impersonation.
Validates that ack.shard_id matches the planned shard assigned to that node.
Rejects ACKs with durability_level < LocallyDurable (rejecting volatile/in-flight/buffered writes).
Records distinct shard IDs in BTreeSet<usize>. Duplicate ACKs for the same shard cannot inflate the durable_shard_count.
Commit requires distinct durable shards >= commit_policy.required_shards (K=12 for degraded commit; 20 for StrictAllShards).
